supportedProfile: Executed trusted Texloom TeX declarations producing validated Bundle versions 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3
Deterministic absolute-time 2D evaluation with immutable shared resources
SVG and native Canvas rendering of the four registered scenes
excluded: Unwrapped arbitrary TikZ animation semantics or universal TeX package support
3D, a general operation graph, topology-changing morphs, numerical PDE solving or manifold simulation
Full Chalkspace lesson scheduler, eraser, sound and frame-cache integration

inputs: Four registered authored TeX scenes and the committed scalar-field sample data; input hashes identify the exact evidence
Finite absolute source time in seconds; out-of-range time holds the nearest scene endpoint
An explicitly recorded local compiler, runtime and browser toolchain
outputs: Validated semantic scene objects, resource geometry and measured TeX boxes; node and paint order are retained
Sampled EvaluatedFrame geometry, camera state and scalar values at fixture-declared times
SVG/Canvas raster observations and structured comparison reports with artifact hashes and tool provenance
coordinates: Scene units are bp, 72 per inch; positive x points right and positive y down
TeX pt measurements convert with 72/72.27; logical width/height/depth and visible ink bounds are distinct
Local transforms compose translate times rotate times scale; parents establish local spaces, while view camera remains separate
Runtime angles are radians; authored TikZ rotation options are degrees before lowering
Length progress is measured in local path coordinates; direction length and perpendicular normal are in world bp before camera application
Scalar-field grid order is row-major, y then x, with linear temporal interpolation between external samples
errorPolicy: Missing required fixtures, invalid PortSpecs, missing immutable upstream revisions, compiler failures and failed comparisons fail verification
Canonical comparison excludes explicitly nonsemantic run/provenance data; it preserves geometry, metrics, style, paint order and data samples
Numerical and raster tolerances are declared by the fixture registry and are not silently widened on failure
Record toolchain drift separately from semantic/raster differences; a mismatch does not authorize automatic golden replacement
Unsupported input and undefined/singular geometry follow existing typed validator/runtime errors; this PR does not broaden accepted semantics

claims: The four fixtures can be compiled and checked using the recorded toolchain and registered inputs
Approved semantic regression evidence can detect changes in the supported objects and sampled coordinates
Repeated and reverse-time samples remain independent of playback history
SVG and Canvas observations meet the declared fixture raster tolerances
An active PortSpec without an immutable source revision is rejected
notEstablished: Identical output bytes across all TeX distributions, fonts, browsers and operating systems
Historical visual correctness from current SVG/Canvas agreement alone
Algorithmic equivalence to the pinned PGF source revision or any Manim/Blender release
Complete upstream test coverage or permission to copy upstream implementation code
General mathematical validity of a numerical solver, a manifold wave model or arbitrary scenes beyond the registered fixtures
